title: Young Boy Sitting on Sunny Grass Lawn, May 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white deckled-edge snapshot photo capturing a young boy sitting happily on a sunny, grassy slope outdoors against a backdrop of thick hedges. He is dressed in classic 1950s style, wearing a patterned knit sweater vest over a shirt, trousers, and pale shoes. The reverse features a handwritten date of May 1950 and a 620 photo processing stamp.
